import numpy as np, pathlib, textwrap
root=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687629/attempts/1a23792c575c414fa559b68921d57662/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]!=0:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            components.append(cells)
    for cells in components:
        boxes={}
        for r,c in cells:
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color not in boxes: boxes[color]=[r,r,c,c]
            else:
                b=boxes[color]; b[0]=min(b[0],r); b[1]=max(b[1],r); b[2]=min(b[2],c); b[3]=max(b[3],c)
        # Nested bands run from the largest bounding box to the smallest. Reverse their colors.
        order=sorted(boxes, key=lambda color: -((boxes[color][1]-boxes[color][0]+1)*(boxes[color][3]-boxes[color][2]+1)))
        remap={color: order[len(order)-1-i] for i,color in enumerate(order)}
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=remap[grid[r][c]]
    return out
'''
